args.text: [lane-ibis] Three risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale answers: users are sent to old addresses after a server moves, so services appear down. (2) Slow recovery: a fix or failover takes longer to reach users because old answers linger. (3) Lingering bad data: a poisoned or wrong answer stays in the cache for longer, so harm lasts longer.

[lane-ibis] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail in ways that leave you unsure whether a request worked, so you must be able to send it again. If the request is idempotent (repeating it gives the same result as doing it once), a retry cannot cause harm such as double charges or duplicate orders.
